main_text.head: D. de Peyresc J. Morino Monita non nulla de Samaritanorum Pentateucho.

head.i:
A MONSIEUR,
Monsieur le R. P. Morin Prof. de l'Orat.

main_text.p: L y a quelque remps que le fils de Mr. Vitray m'apporta une letre,noftre,contenant certaines reliqves de monumens Puniqves,dont vous me faisiés l'honneur de me demander la communication,que je seray tres aise de vous despartir,n'aiant rien que ne soit à vostre service, & à vostre disposition. La queftion estoit de trouver tems & le loisir de foviller parmi mes layetes pour entirer ce qvi pouvoit vous estre duisable, ce que j'en ay encore pû rencontrer à mon grand regret, & m' attendois à nos prochaines vacations pour tascher de vous pouvoir satisfaire en cela & en toute autre chose, que je jugeray pouvoir tomber dans vostre goust. Mais ayant appris que vous aviés rendu

page.notes: The drop cap "I" is joined to "Ly" as "ILy"; the scan shows it as a large initial, read here as "I" with [?] not required, but the initial is blurred. "remps" is printed as such (likely "temps"), kept as printed. "qvi" and "qve" are kept in the u/v-corrected form ("qui" and "que" would be the normal spelling); the printed q-v forms are otherwise read as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Several lines are blurred by scan noise and show-through; readings in the body are based on clear letter forms. The catchword "à MSS" and signature "S 3" are read from the foot of the page.
